sloka: तमुग्रवेगं संरब्धमापतन्तं महाकपिः ।ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य जग्राह महावेगो महाशिलाम् ।। ६.५८.५२ ।।।।
transliteration: tamugravegaṁ saṁrabdhamāpatantaṁ mahākapiḥ ।tataḥ samprekṣya jagrāha mahāvego mahāśilām ।। 6.58.52 ।।।।

translations.english: He (Prahastha), not caring for the wound, taking a huge mallet went towards that courageous monkey (Neela).
